answer_4.quote: we recruited two more professional journalists (N=3 total) to annotate the same 100 NYT article pairs as pairwise preferences... Inter-annotator agreement was moderate... human evaluators judge policies ranked highly by these models as being particularly valuable for journalists and highly useful... presented these results to a group of journalists (n = 100), and 81% of respondents indicated they were impressed
answer_4.guideline: Journalists rank-ordered article pairs and evaluated summarized policies for journalistic utility
